sections.whatsHappening: You have attempted to serve the claim to the defendant, but the delivery has failed. You can file a motion for substituted service if you cannot find the defendant or if they are avoiding service.
sections.whatToDoNext: File a Notice of Motion and Supporting Affidavit [Form 15A] to request an order for substituted service. You must explain to the court why you could not serve the claim personally.
sections.yourDeadline: Serve the claim on the defendant. You have 6 months, counted from the date the claim was issued.
sections.whatHappensAfter: If the court grants your motion for substituted service, you will need to serve the defendant using the method ordered by the court.
